scope: QA-03 route leg beyond maximum train fuel capacity
finding: A structurally valid circular route could be committed even when one leg required more coal than its train could ever hold (station count × 50). It would remain in FuelWait after a full refuel.
change: Route inspection reports InsufficientTankRange with required coal, tank maximum, affected leg and a recovery hint.
Commit and subsequent route validation reject such a route; the route UI names the issue 연료칸 거리 초과.
limits: This is a model and compiled UI-label verification in the connected Editor; no physical pointer interaction or long live route was run.
Other QA-03 cases (adjacent branch during travel, lost station reference, curved-path and arrival-time continuity) remain.
